title: Black & White Entrance Arch
description: A full-height arch in black, white, and printed balloons spanning a pair of banquet-room doors, with a black satin bow at the crown and weighted columns at both feet. Built as a threshold piece — guests walk through it rather than past it.

alt.entrance-arch-centered.jpg: A black and white balloon arch spanning double banquet-room doors with a black satin bow at the crown
alt.entrance-arch-wide.jpg: A wide view of a black and white balloon arch framing the entrance to a banquet room
